summary: The Videos library and player now match the chat design, using its shared typography, light palette, Veyra branding and navigation.
instructions: Open Videos from the chat navigation, browse a folder and select a lesson. Both the library and player now use chat-consistent surfaces, buttons, spacing and focus indicators, with responsive layouts for phones and desktops. Playback, seeking and Previous/Next links are unchanged. Browser layout checks passed at 320, 390, 1024 and 1905 pixels; media HTTP/range/authentication tests and all 32 web-chat tests also passed. Actual iPhone playback has not been verified.
